Guided setup
Open the guide: learn Grayjoy and change your choices at any time.
Welcome to Grayjoy

Videos, music and your favourite creators, together in one app. Search, follow channels, save playlists and download content for offline playback. Let’s set things up together: nothing here requires technical knowledge.
Every choice can be changed later in Prefs. The magician at the top left of Home always reopens this guide. Skipping does not delete your data.

Find your way around
Try the buttons in the bar below to discover each section, without leaving this guide. In the app, you will find the same bar at the bottom, or at the side on tablets.
Home collects videos from your subscriptions, Shorts and recommendations. Tap a video to play it. Swipe the player down to keep listening while browsing.
Follow a channel to find its uploads here. You can refresh, filter by creator and manage your subscriptions.
Type a title, artist or topic. Enabled sources supply the results. Hold a video to see more actions.
Your history, Watch later, playlists and downloads live here. Hold a video to select several and add them to a playlist.
Change playback, appearance and privacy here. Use the new search field to find a setting. Open Sources to add platforms and manage their logins.
A simpler start
Ask YouTube or Spotify at startup

Would you like two big buttons at startup? This creates separate YouTube and Spotify profiles with just that source enabled. Each keeps its own library and logins; your existing profiles are not changed. Spotify searches its catalogue and plays matching audio from YouTube; it does not require a Spotify subscription.
You are configuring the profile: %1$s. Select a dedicated profile below before signing in or importing.
Configure YouTube profile
Configure Spotify profile
What would you like to use?
Choose a profile. Its library and settings stay separate. You can turn this question off in Prefs → Guided setup.
Continue with current profile
This dedicated profile was deleted. Reopen Guided setup and enable the startup choice again to recreate it.
Could not complete setup
Choose the look
Automatic follows the Android theme. Light is brighter; Dark is more comfortable at night. You can also use colours from your wallpaper.
Connect YouTube, if you want

Signing in is optional. It lets Grayjoy import your subscriptions, playlists, history and liked videos. The Google sign-in page opens: enter your details there, then follow the instructions to finish. No data is imported until you choose it in the next steps.
Without signing in you can still search and watch public videos. Importing your YouTube account will not be available. You can sign in later from Prefs → Sources → YouTube.
YouTube is connected for this profile.
Sign in to YouTube
Other platforms
If you use another enabled platform, you can sign in here when its plugin supports it. Paid content still requires the relevant subscription.
Skipping leaves account-only content unavailable on platforms where you have not signed in. Public content is unaffected. You can manage access later in Sources.
Only other enabled platforms are listed here. More platforms can be enabled or installed from Prefs → Sources.
Bring your favourites with you
Choose what to copy from YouTube into the current profile. Existing items are kept and duplicates are merged. Large libraries continue in the background: the Jobs button shows their progress.
Without importing, your remote subscriptions and playlists will not automatically appear here. You can add them yourself or import later from Sources → YouTube. Existing local data is kept.

Brainrot mode plays the Shorts in Home as a full-screen vertical feed. Swipe up for the next video and down for the previous one. If disabled, Shorts use the ordinary player. This mode is for phones, not tablets.
Available on phone-sized screens only.
A hand touches the screen and swipes up for the next short video, then down to return to the previous one.
Swipe up · Next video
Swipe down · Previous video
Hold a finger on the video to watch at double speed. Release it to return to your previous speed. This is optional and does not change the normal playback speed.
Demonstration: hold to play at 2×; release to return to normal.

SponsorBlock uses community reports to identify sponsored segments inside YouTube videos. They appear in light green on the timeline. It does not block every kind of ad. You can choose categories in Prefs and override them for individual channels or videos.
Skip segments automatically
With automatic skipping off, a Skip segment button appears when a marked segment starts. Seeking into a segment manually lets you watch it without being skipped out.
Skip segment
Demonstration: the playhead skips a green sponsored segment.

At the end of a YouTube video, Grayjoy can suggest and play the next one. You will see its title, a 10-second countdown and a Cancel button, also in fullscreen. This temporary queue is not saved among your playlists. Your own playlists keep their usual order.
You’re ready!
Your choices are saved as you make them, for the current profile. Try searching for a video or opening your library. Remember: you can always return to this guide using the magician in Home.
Open the YouTube menu
Tap the ☰ menu at the top left of the page, as shown by the arrow. Then choose the account/channel you want to use to complete sign-in.
Would you like to import your data?
Choose where to import from. These options only show the next step: nothing is imported until you start it there. Leave both off to continue without importing.
Import from my YouTube account
Import a Grayjay or NewPipe backup
Do not import anything

No new import will be started from this guide. You can do this later:

• YouTube: Prefs → Sources → YouTube → Import from YouTube.
• A Grayjay or NewPipe backup: Prefs → Data → the corresponding import option.

Your existing library is kept.
An import is already running. This choice does not cancel it: you can manage it from Active jobs.
Choose a Grayjay or NewPipe backup file. You will be able to review what to import before confirming. Existing local data is kept.
